what_it_is: birdybro's own MiSTer TurboGrafx16 (CD) save, from a zip of their whole MiSTer saves folder (saves/TGFX16, file dated 2021-02-22): a BRAM whose header says empty (next free 0x8010) but whose bytes still hold a DYNASTIC01 entry: a file the game or the user deleted, the data left in place as the HUBM format does.
note: Raw 2 KiB backup RAM, no padding: HUBM, end pointer 0x8800, next free 0x8010, entries: none. Not booted here. The zip is the same one the pcengine worker downloaded (.cache/downloads/pcengine/birdybro-mister-saves/saves.zip, sha1 9ced6d6c8b2047fe8225aaf37201e15095da3ace); the file was copied from its extracted TGFX16/ folder.
